I met up with Heather, the creator of Porch Pumpkins, and we talked about how she turned decorating porches into one of the most profitable seasonal side hustles you’ll ever hear about. What started with a goal of doing 30 homes quickly grew into hundreds of thousands of dollars in revenue each season, with profit margins that would make most entrepreneurs jealous. Heather shared how she built the business from scratch, the packages she offers, and why great design and customer service are the key to making this work. We also talked about how she sources pumpkins directly from farms, what it takes to manage routes and deliveries, and how Instagram has been her biggest driver of growth.

Now Heather is expanding into business coaching and even launching Porch Pumpkins franchises so more people can bring this idea to their own city.

You can learn more at https://porchpumpkins.com and follow along on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/porchpumpkins
